resources: Edward Tufte’s The Visual Display of Quantitative Information - ISBN-13: 978-1930824133

Question 

How do we represent information flow when we interact with different media, especially text?


Maps shape how we see and understand the world, which in turn shapes how we act within it.
maps
Linus’ talk on Representation
how maps shape our agency
as technology
Viégas and Wattenberg propose a dashboard beside an AI conversation, exposing selected parts of the system’s model of itself and of the person using it. Their proposal assumes those internal models can be identified and interpreted. They describe the design as speculative and report no user studies; which features would help someone use the system remains open. (Viégas & Wattenberg, 2023)
How can we manipulate new ideas and abstractions to create new notations?
Thesis: Technologies for representation mediate how we see the world.
Tenet:

A representation must abstract
An interface always gives or takes agency. Be intentional about which you choose
Represent to communicate, not model.

internals grokking
What could understanding an AI system’s internal representations tell us about how we think? Establishing a connection would require evidence about human cognition too.
Seeing clearly to exercise agency
interface
Instrumental use:

frictionless input, low-latency progress: payments.

Engaged use:

See the information relevant to a decision. Express intent naturally and precisely.
Explore possibilities by interacting with the information.


Why don't we do this more? 

It is a hyperreal produced from a radiating synthesis of combinatory models in a hyperspace without atmosphere.


Simulacra and Simulation, Jean Baudrillard

Art of Cartography attained such Perfection that the map of a single Province occupied the entirely of a City […] saw that that vast Map was Useless...
